free-coding.description: Free coding lane. Large-context free models first: nemotron-3-ultra took a 23k-token Claude Code payload and nemotron-3.5-lightning a 29k opencode one (JET-356, JET-358, 2026-09-06); groq gpt-oss-120b 413s above 8k TPM and codestral answers agentic turns with stubs, both kept as tail fallbacks.

free-thinking.description: Free reasoning lane — only models that actually think. No local floor: a 27B dense model on this laptop froze it on 2026-09-05, and a stop is better than a freeze. Refreshed 2026-09-08 after all 6 members died at once (delisted qwen3.8-27b / glm-5.2 / inkling, uncredentialed cfp): every member below answered a real 1-token probe that day — probe before trusting, free catalogs churn without notice.
